infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ResQDrive needs microphone access to detect acoustic crash sounds and process voice commands.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ResQDrive needs camera access to capture photographs of vehicle collision damage.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ResQDrive requires your location to navigate to the nearest hospitals and dispatch responders.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: ResQDrive connects to your in-vehicle ESP32 IoT sensor node via Bluetooth Low Energy.
